headline: Five months of continuous rise: where inflation has reached in Cyprus
summary: Inflation in Cyprus stands at 5.2% in September, according to Eurostat, and has risen for five consecutive months. The rate is estimated to remain at the same level for 2026.
why: Consumer price inflation drives central bank policy expectations and bond yields, and is a key input for investors assessing eurozone member economies.
